related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment session-context regression tests and repository verification

commands: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_environment.py -k 'context_exposes_bounded_capability_availability_attention or context_lists_exact_binding_ids_for_available_capabilities or context_surfaces_bounded_unknown_capability_opportunities'

outcome.coverage: The regression test covers an eight-binding cap, omitted counts, stable resolution identifiers, redaction of free-text reasons and paths, aggregation of unknown reason codes, category bounds, and explicit missing-reason counts.

pre_change_full_suite_baseline.failure_scope: Pre-change failures were in tests/test_capability_intelligence.py ECI response-budget/compaction cases; they were observed before this implementation was edited.

outcome.interpretation_limit: The focused tests verify bounded context output and the real selected-session readback below verifies the current snapshot relationship. Neither establishes longer-term burden reduction or service effectiveness.

pressure_hypothesis.title: First-use context reports unavailable capability counts without exposing a bounded actionable cause
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment selected-session context and capability bindings
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose a bounded binding-level availability summary in first-use context with stable resolution identifiers, while keeping unknown bindings distinct and omitting free-text reasons and filesystem paths.

not_measured: The ten pre-change ECI failures were not rerun after this change because they were outside the edited context path.
Cross-session behavior, alternate provider contracts, and long-term agent intervention.
